The user wants an extended, detailed engineering tutorial on designing a "reliable service" based on the provided document. The document is extremely repetitive (the same sentence repeated hundreds of times): "A reliable service records requests, validates inputs, processes jobs and handles failures."

I need to write a comprehensive engineering tutorial (at least 1500 words) covering:
1. Designing this service
2. Examples
3. Failure analysis
4. Testing

Structure should be:
- Introduction/Overview
- Core Requirements (derived from the sentence: record requests, validate inputs, process jobs, handle failures)
- Architecture/Design
